# The ceiling on deflection is set by product clar

`customer_support.mm.self_service_deflection.the_ceiling_on_deflection_is_set_by_product_clar` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> The ceiling on deflection is set by product clarity, not by content quality.

Past a point, more and better articles describe a confusing product more fluently. Recognising the ceiling is what turns a knowledge team from a documentation function into a product-feedback function.
